The test image shows a corn leaf with a single small, bright white circular spot on an otherwise healthy green leaf — this is the classic early presentation of Holcus spot.

The reference images confirm this match: multiple Holcus_spot collage panels (especially bottom-left and bottom-right) show identical small white circular spots on green corn leaves with the same leaf texture and background. The spot in the test image matches the "round to white spots ~1/8 to 1/4 inch diameter" description exactly.
